spans.s:
m. (-रः)
1 A thief, a robber.
2 A perfume called commonly by the same name.
f. (-रा)
A plant: see चोरपुष्पी.
E.
चुर to steal, affix अच; also with कन added चोरक.

m. (-कः)
A kind of grass, commonly Corkānta, (Andropogon aciculatum.)
E.
चोर, and कण्टक a thorn: the seeds clinging to the feet and clothes of those who walk amongst it.

f. (-ष्पी)
A kind of grass, (Andropogon aciculatum.)
E.
चोर a thief, and पुष्प a flower, fem. affix ङीष्: see the last; also with कन् added चोरपुष्पिका.
